# User Validation UAT

Validate the approved slice against user journeys and intended outcomes, separately from technical verification. Prepare a concise UAT script mapped to AC IDs, test data, expected user-visible behavior and evidence. Include accessibility/usability states where relevant. Clearly mark unexecuted tests. Summarize whether the slice solves the approved need, limitations and user decisions. Ask for `ACCEPT SLICE <ID>` or changes.
